base-field.description: BaseField is an internal (i.e., not exported in the index.js) primitive component used for building more complex fields like TextField. It provides error handling and focus styles for field components. It does not handle layout of the component aside from wrapping the field in a Flex wrapper.

alignment-matrix-control.description: AlignmentMatrixControl components enable adjustments to horizontal and vertical alignments for UI.

angle-picker-control.description: AnglePickerControl is a React component to render a UI that allows users to pick an angle. Users can choose an angle in a visual UI with the mouse by dragging an angle indicator inside a circle or by directly inserting the desired angle in a text field.

animate.description: Simple interface to introduce animations to components.

autocomplete.description: This component is used to provide autocompletion support for a child input component. The Autocomplete component is not currently intended to be used as a standalone component. It is used by other packages to provide autocompletion support for the block editor.

base-control.description: BaseControl is a low-level component used to generate labels and help text for components handling user inputs.

border-box-control.description: An input control for the color, style, and width of the border of a box. The border can be customized as a whole, or individually for each side of the box.

border-control.description: An input control for a border's color, style, and width. Border radius is not covered by this control as it may be desired separate to color, style, and width.

box-control.description: A control that lets users set values for top, right, bottom, and left. Can be used as an input control for values like padding or margin.

button.description: Lets users take actions and make choices with a single click or tap.

button-group.description: ButtonGroup can be used to group any related buttons together. To emphasize related buttons, a group should share a common container.

card.description: Card provides a flexible and extensible content container.

checkbox-control.description: Checkboxes allow the user to select one or more items from a set.

clipboard-button.description: With a clipboard button, users copy text (or other elements) with a single click or tap.

color-indicator.description: ColorIndicator is a React component that renders a specific color in a circle. It's often used to summarize a collection of used colors in a child component.

color-palette.description: ColorPalette allows the user to pick a color from a list of pre-defined color entries.

color-picker.description: ColorPicker is a color picking component based on react-colorful that lets you pick a color visually or by manipulating RGB(A), HSL(A), and hex values.

combobox-control.description: ComboboxControl is an enhanced SelectControl with autocomplete/filtering, allowing users to choose from predefined options or enter a custom value.

custom-gradient-picker.description: CustomGradientPicker allows users to pick a gradient from a predefined set or create a custom one.

custom-select-control.description: CustomSelectControl allows selection of one or more items from a short list, using a custom select control with more flexible styling than SelectControl.

dashicon.description: Dashicon displays a single Dashicon from the WordPress Dashicon set as an SVG icon.

date-time-picker.description: DateTimePicker renders a combined date and time input for selecting a specific moment.

disabled.description: Disabled is a wrapper component that disables pointer events and dims child elements when isDisabled is true.

draggable.description: Draggable is a Component that provides a way to set up a cross-browser (including touch) customizable draggable UI element.

drop-zone.description: DropZone is a React component that renders a drop zone for dragging and dropping files.

dropdown.description: Dropdown is a React component to render a dropdown menu, typically used to display a set of actions.

dropdown-menu.description: DropdownMenu displays a list of actions in a dropdown menu, triggered by a button.

duotone-picker.description: DuotonePicker renders a duotone filter picker that lets users choose shadow and highlight colors from a palette.

elevation.description: Elevation is a component that adds a shadow to its content to convey depth along the z-axis.

external-link.description: ExternalLink is a link to an external resource that includes an icon indicating it opens in a new tab.

flex.description: Flex is a layout component that wraps flex items and provides a consistent spacing API.

focal-point-picker.description: FocalPointPicker renders a UI that allows selecting a focal point on an image for object-fit positioning.

font-size-picker.description: FontSizePicker renders a UI that allows users to select a font size from a preset list or enter a custom value.

form-toggle.description: FormToggle renders a toggle switch for boolean on/off settings, styled for form usage.

form-token-field.description: FormTokenField renders an input field that accepts tokens (tags) with optional autocomplete suggestions.

gradient-picker.description: GradientPicker allows users to pick a gradient from a predefined set or create a custom gradient.

guide.description: Guide is a React component that displays user tips in a stepped sequence, using GuidePage for each step.

heading.description: Heading renders semantic heading text with consistent typography styles for a given level.

h-stack.description: HStack is a horizontal layout component that arranges children in a row with consistent spacing.

icon.description: Icon renders an SVG icon from the WordPress icons library with consistent sizing.

input-control.description: InputControl is a text input component with built-in label, help, and error handling.

menu-group.description: MenuGroup groups related MenuItem components under a shared label in a menu.

menu-item.description: MenuItem represents a single actionable item within a menu or menu group.

menu-items-choice.description: MenuItemsChoice renders a set of mutually exclusive (or multiple) choices inside a menu.

modal.description: Modal displays content in an overlay dialog that traps focus until dismissed.

navigable-menu.description: NavigableMenu is a menu container that supports keyboard navigation between items.

navigator.description: Navigator provides a stack-based navigation pattern with screens and transitions between views.

notice.description: Notice displays a dismissible admin-style message with status variants (success, warning, error, info).

notice-list.description: NoticeList renders a collection of Notice components with shared remove handling.

panel.description: Panel is a container for grouped settings UI, typically composed of PanelBody and PanelRow children.

placeholder.description: Placeholder renders an empty-state container with icon, label, and instructions for setup flows.

popover.description: Popover displays floating content anchored to a trigger element, such as a button.

progress-bar.description: ProgressBar displays progress toward completion as a horizontal bar.

query-controls.description: QueryControls provides controls for ordering and sorting query results in block interfaces.

radio-control.description: RadioControl allows users to select a single option from a set of radio buttons.

range-control.description: RangeControl lets users select a numeric value within a range using a slider.

badge.description: Badge displays a compact label for status, counts, or metadata alongside other UI.

calendar.description: Calendar components let users pick dates from a month grid or date range.

circular-option-picker.description: CircularOptionPicker renders circular options, commonly used for color or style swatches.

composite.description: Composite provides roving tabindex and keyboard navigation for grouped interactive items.

confirm-dialog.description: ConfirmDialog asks users to confirm or cancel a destructive or important action.

custom-select-control-v2.description: CustomSelectControlV2 is the underlying select implementation used by CustomSelectControl.

divider.description: Divider renders a horizontal or vertical rule to separate content sections.

focusable-iframe.description: FocusableIframe renders an iframe that can receive keyboard focus within the editor.

form-file-upload.description: FormFileUpload renders a button that opens a file picker for uploading files.

grid.description: Grid is a layout component that arranges children in a responsive CSS grid.

higher-order.description: Higher-order components are utility wrappers (for example withNotices) rather than visual UI on their own.

isolated-event-container.description: IsolatedEventContainer stops event propagation from its children to parent handlers.

item-group.description: ItemGroup groups related Item components with consistent spacing and semantics.

keyboard-shortcuts.description: KeyboardShortcuts registers keyboard shortcuts and displays them in a help dialog.

menu.description: Menu patterns combine menu containers and items for actionable lists.

mobile.description: Mobile preview patterns use ResponsiveWrapper to simulate constrained viewports.

number-control.description: NumberControl lets users enter numeric values with optional spin buttons and constraints.

radio-group.description: RadioGroup renders a set of radio inputs for selecting a single option.

resizable-box.description: ResizableBox wraps content in a box that users can resize by dragging handles.

responsive-wrapper.description: ResponsiveWrapper scales embedded content to fit its container while preserving aspect ratio.

sandbox.description: SandBox safely renders HTML in an isolated iframe for previews and embeds.

scroll-lock.description: ScrollLock prevents background scrolling while overlays or modals are open.

scrollable.description: Scrollable wraps content in a scrollable region with consistent styling.

search-control.description: SearchControl provides a search input field with optional label and help text.

select-control.description: SelectControl renders a native-style select dropdown for choosing one option.

slot-fill.description: Slot and Fill let distant components share UI regions via a provider pattern.

snackbar.description: Snackbar and SnackbarList display brief, dismissible messages at the bottom of the screen.

spacer.description: Spacer adds consistent whitespace between layout elements.

spinner.description: Spinner indicates loading or processing state with an animated icon.

surface.description: Surface provides a styled container background for grouped content.

tab-panel.description: TabPanel renders a tabbed interface where each tab shows different content.

tabs.description: Tabs organize related content into selectable panels with shared navigation.

text.description: Text renders typography with consistent sizing, weight, and color tokens.

text-control.description: TextControl is a single-line text input with label and help text.

text-highlight.description: TextHighlight emphasizes matching substrings within a larger text value.

textarea-control.description: TextareaControl is a multi-line text input for longer content.

theme.description: Theme and StyleProvider supply design tokens and scoped styles to child components.

toggle-control.description: ToggleControl combines a FormToggle with a label for boolean settings.

toggle-group-control.description: ToggleGroupControl replaces ButtonGroup with accessible segmented toggle options.

toolbar.description: Toolbar groups ToolbarButton and ToolbarGroup controls for rich editing interfaces.

tools-panel.description: ToolsPanel organizes block settings into collapsible panel sections with reset support.

tooltip.description: Tooltip displays supplementary information when hovering or focusing an element.

tree-grid.description: TreeGrid renders hierarchical data in an accessible grid with keyboard navigation.

tree-select.description: TreeSelect displays hierarchical options in a select control with indentation.

truncate.description: Truncate ellipsizes overflowing text while preserving readable typography.

unit-control.description: UnitControl combines a numeric input with unit selection (px, em, rem, etc.).

v-stack.description: VStack arranges children vertically with consistent spacing.

view.description: View is a primitive layout component for spacing, alignment, and display styles.

visually-hidden.description: VisuallyHidden hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

z-stack.description: ZStack layers children along the z-axis with offset positioning.
